question: For each instance system metadata key, show the key name and compute (1) the range (maximum minus minimum) of the migrated instances’ memory in MB and (2) the variance of that memory in MB, considering only migrations with status = 'completed' and only instances hosted on 'blaze8-12'. Do not return any rounded answers.

  ism.`key` AS key_name,
  MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb,
  VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb
FROM instance_system_metadata AS ism

JOIN migrations AS m
  ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
WHERE m.status = 'completed'
  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
